steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Your Party Bar
steps.body:
See those hero cards at the bottom of the screen? That's your Party Bar. It shows every hero in your active party at a glance — their stats, health, and equipment.

You can manage everything about your party right from there.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Gear Management
steps.body:
Click the Gear button on any hero card to equip weapons, armor, and accessories. You can also equip a backpack in the Bag slot to carry more items into the dungeon.

Below the equipment you'll see the hero's bag — fill it with consumables like potions before heading out. Preparation saves lives.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Row Formations
steps.body:
Below the Gear button you'll see three position buttons — F, M, and B — for Front, Middle, and Back rows.

Melee enemies target your Front row first, so put your toughest fighters there. But beware — ranged enemies can target any row and will pick off your weakest hero. Keep everyone healthy, not just your front line.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: One More Thing
steps.body:
Before you head into the dungeon, visit the Shop! You'll find consumables like healing potions as well as weapons and armor. What's available depends on your facility tiers and unlocked recipes, so invest in upgrades when you can.

Good luck out there, Shopkeeper. I'll keep an eye out for fresh recruits while you're gone — there's always a few brave souls drifting through the Inn looking for work.
